problem.title: All One Data Structure
problem.problemStatement: Design a data structure that supports the following operations in constant time: inc(key) — Increment the count of the given key. dec(key) — Decrement the count of the given key. Remove the key if its count becomes zero. getMaxKey() — Return any key with the maximum count. getMinKey() — Return any key with the minimum count. Process a sequence of operations and print the results of every getMaxKey() and getMinKey() query.
problem.output: Print the result for every getMaxKey() and getMinKey() operation.
problem.constraints: 1 <= q <= 5 × 10^4 Keys consist of lowercase English letters.
